_head: Phase 1's measurements, replayable. Boxes are design pt at 3 capture px to the pt; run with --pt 3. `img` is assets/refs/pN.png, the Nth Mobbin capture as it exported: 1179x2676, which is 393x852pt plus the 120px Mobbin footer that sits below every probe here. --against wants scratch/shot, which scratch/run.py fills with the seven boards rendered at 3x with --crop-phone; every probe names its own board there. Nothing is probed on the Dynamic Island (x 134-259 y 11-47), the home indicator (x 127-266 y 839-846) or the 52pt display corners -- those three are this repo's frame and the capture carries none of them. Every probe replays a run both sides draw. Eight left the file when 07 took @Yilin0x's own timeline: spaces, chip, chip-ink, m-card, m-play and t-space read the Spaces card no board draws now, and t-name and t-meta the demo persona's name and location -- and a run the bio's second line pushes down cannot be probed anyway, since one box is read on both images. Those eight measurements stay on the 00b-00d evidence boards, which quote the capture and are not replayed against a render.
